Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

pelagicOM 0.1.2 (2026-11-22)

  • Package website (pkgdown) at https://rodrigosantana.github.io/pelagicOM/, built and deployed to GitHub Pages by a GitHub Actions workflow. Eight articles cover the spatial domain, Part I (biomass), Part II (fishery), the observation process and scenarios, tuning for other species, outputs and data dictionary, every parameter (generated from the preset) and the proof of reproduction of Experimento 02.
  • sf is now imported in the NAMESPACE, so its methods are available as soon as pelagicOM is loaded. Before this, the bundled cell polygons (read with readRDS()) could be handled as plain data frames, and fig_maps() / fig_base_habitat() failed in a fresh session where no sf function had been called yet.
  • strategy_recovery_diagnostic() silences the harmless “Quick-TRANSfer” warning of kmeans(); its results do not change.
  • All examples (README, vignette, articles, help pages) are based on BET. The complete tuning example is an alternative BET operating model: four regions, northward redistribution, fleet E removed and a new fleet F.
  • The map of ICCAT stock areas (article “Spatial domain”) now draws one panel per species, with each stock area labelled on the map. In the old facetted layout the east and west areas of a species (e.g. SKJ-E / SKJ-W) looked swapped.

pelagicOM 0.1.1 (2026-11-22)

  • lwgeom and sf are now required (Imports). Every cell area is geodesic on the WGS84 ellipsoid, computed by lwgeom::st_geod_area() through the new exported helper geodesic_area_km2(). This is exactly the computation of Experimento 02 (sf::st_area() with s2 off).
  • om_domain_from_gpkg() uses lwgeom explicitly and, with the defaults, rebuilds the Experimento 02 domain from ICCAT_gis.gpkg with identical cells, lattice and polygons. New argument selection: "intersects" (Experimento 02) or "point_on_surface" (same cells as om_domain_iccat() for smaller stock areas); also available as cfg$spatial$selection.
  • om_domain_grid() now uses geodesic (ellipsoidal) areas instead of the spherical formula, so open-ocean cells have the same area as in the ICCAT grid.
  • The bundled ICCAT grid (inst/extdata) is now built from the GeoPackage by om_domain_from_gpkg() (data-raw/build_iccat_grid.R), with a check against the saved domain of Experimento 02. Its content is unchanged.
  • Maps and domains attach the cell geometry by default (geometry = TRUE).

pelagicOM 0.1.0 (2026-11-22)

  • First version, built from the simulation components of Experimento 02 (Simulacao_Biomassa/ and Simulacao_Pesca/).
  • BET_ICCAT preset: reproduces bit for bit the biomass truth, the fishery truth and the eight scenario data sets of Experimento 02 (inst/scripts/reproduce_experimento02.R, om_compare_reference()).
  • Bundled ICCAT 1x1 grid with 24 stock areas (om_domain_iccat(), iccat_stocks()); GeoPackage reader (om_domain_from_gpkg()) and synthetic grids (om_domain_grid()).
  • Generalisations with neutral defaults: free latitudinal regions, envelope on absolute latitude (temperate species), user habitat layers (habitat$custom_effect), any number and names of fleets (om_fleet()), configurable drifting strategy, om_config_update().
  • Simulations no longer change the caller’s random number stream.
